nodes.label: Globe SVG Icon
nodes.description: A 16x16 globe/world icon rendered in gray (#666). Depicts a spherical Earth with latitude/longitude grid lines and elliptical meridian curves, conveying internationalization, web/internet, or global connectivity. Used as a UI icon, likely for language selection, internationalization (i18n), or external link indicators.

nodes.label: Window Icon SVG
nodes.description: A 16x16 SVG icon depicting a browser or application window. It shows a rectangular window frame with a top bar (title bar area) and three small circular dots (buttons) in the upper-left corner, representing minimize/maximize/close controls typical of a macOS or desktop window chrome. The icon uses gray (#666) fill on a transparent background.
nodes.purpose: UI icon representing a browser window, application window, or windowed view context
